Needs changes before merge. One blocking finding.

This is the first review of this head. I read the whole diff and the current upstream laws. This is a safety review because the change adds geometry used for wire posting.

**What looks good**

- The independent curve checks and the pinning tests pass.
- The new spline die golden is listed in the body. I read all 162 lines. No existing golden moved.
- The partial issue stays open through `Refs #1865`. The MIT licence text remains present.

**Local results**

The trial merge is `0d3c741486062ef5c9c119a69430bbadb6c8a74c`. Its first parent is this PR head. Its main parent is `ddee3aed6064eefe157110ab8923dbb02e1591ca`.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 1,206 steps; 1,203 passed, 3 failed, 0 stalled. Wall time: 39.3 minutes. The geometry change selects the batch plan.
- Strict clippy passed for all selected crates and all targets, with `-D warnings`.
- The failures are `ui suites: lib`, `ui suites: egui_app` and `ui suites: shell`. They have 7, 3 and 1 failed tests.
- I ran all three failing suites again on bare upstream main `d3c2bf0bae31f99809984032b2f778afeddf4d8a`. All 11 failing test names match. The adapter diagnostics match too. These are environment failures, not PR regressions. I found no open issue for these exact UI failures.

```text
Failed to create render state: CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")
egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter
```

**Extra suites run**

These suites ran again by name after the quick gate:

| Crate | Suite | Result |
|---|---|---|
| geometry | dxf | 23 passed |
| geometry | dxf_refusals | 19 passed |
| kernel | step_agreement | 29 passed |
| kernel | machining_mesh | 7 passed |
| app | feature_edge_g1_join | 5 passed |
| app | wire_dxf_selection | 7 passed |

The quick gate also ran `example_catalog` (43 passed, 4 heavy tests ignored), `example_catalog_adaptive` (1 passed) and `example_catalog_edge_work` (1 passed). The golden consumers include `conformance` (7 passed), `solid_law_goldens` (7 passed) and `wire_iso_decimal` (2 passed). The remaining golden consumers ran in the batch plan and passed.

The full set of 11 light twins passed in 5 steps, with 0 failures and 0 stalls. Wall time: 6.3 minutes. Command: `cargo xtask gate light --only "motion light" --only "app light"`. This selects every light test step and omits only the separate build of all release test binaries. Each selected step builds its own target.

**Mutations**

- GREEN: the PR's degree 0 SPLINE mutation returns `SPLINE: degree must be 1 to 11`.
- GREEN: the PR's ELLIPSE with ratio 0 mutation returns `ELLIPSE: axis ratio must be above 0 and at most 1`.
- GREEN: `mutated_curve_records_never_panic` completed its 300 fixed-seed inputs.
- RED: the probe with an omitted Z below is accepted. The closed version also passes `SketchData::from_dxf`.

**Requested before merge**

1. **Blocking: coordinate completeness.** Validate Z for each SPLINE control point. `crates/geometry/src/dxf/curves.rs:220` compares only explicit group-30 values. It does not check the Z of each point. A degree-1 spline with controls `(0, 0, 1)` and `(10, 0, omitted)` reads as an XY line with elevation 1. The same record with an explicit second Z of 0 returns `SPLINE: control points are not in one Z plane`. A closed square with five control points with only the first Z set to 1 also reads successfully. `SketchData::from_dxf` accepts its four lines. Thus, missing data bypasses the plane check and produces usable geometry. Validate X, Y and Z as one control point before the next point or the record end. Apply the supported Z default consistently, or refuse an incomplete record. Reject orphan or duplicate Z fields. Use one rule for all control points. Add regression tests for mixed explicit and omitted Z values, in both orders. Keep the all-zero case supported. The [public DXF reference](https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2024/ENU/AutoCAD-DXF/files/GUID-E1F884F8-AA90-4864-A215-3182D47A9C74.htm) defines a Z entry per control point.

**Optional, non-blocking**

- `crates/geometry/src/dxf/nurbs.rs:177`: cache whether the weights are equal. `speed()` scans every weight for each span. This gives quadratic work for a long non-rational spline. The review probe read 32,000 collinear controls from a 991,325-byte input in 14.7 seconds.
- `crates/geometry/src/dxf/curves.rs:119`: the near-circle shortcut uses only the ratio. At radius `1e10` mm and ratio `0.9999999999995`, the reader emits a circle with a 0.005001 mm error and records no curve tolerance. The current sketch range guard rejects this extreme drawing. Thus, this does not block the present application path. A check that includes the radius would preserve the reader's stated bound too.

No full heavy lane ran. This is a P4 issue; the current upstream law requires the light twins at review. No source, golden, screenshot or review evidence was committed. The review worktree and branch remain in place.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: SPLINE control point coordinate completeness.

The reader checks X, Y, and Z together. An omitted Z is zero for that point. The reader rejects orphan and duplicate Z fields and points in different Z planes.

`spline_control_points_use_a_per_point_z_default` and `spline_control_points_refuse_orphan_and_duplicate_z` pin this change. Both failed with the original parser and passed with the fix. The DXF suites passed all 44 tests.

New head: `62b3fdf174b4c02278ce03fa1c2e5d4ee33c7e25`. Clippy, the catalog suites, and the wire goldens passed. Quick had three UI adapter failures from the prior review. Heavy had one pocket move-count failure. The same count failure reproduced with the original parser.

Please re-review this head.

Thank you for the fix of item 1 in `62b3fdf17`. I kept your commit as it is. The new commit `8973feb08` is on top of it and changes only the two optional items.

**Item 2: equal weights (optional).**
- `Nurbs::new` finds one time if all weights are equal (`uniform`). `speed()` reads this flag. It does not scan the weights for each span.
- 40,000 collinear control points in a debug build: 13.8 s before, 0.5 s after.
- Pinned by `curve_bounds::a_long_non_rational_spline_reads_in_linear_time` (limit 5 s).

**Item 3: near-round ellipse (optional).**
- A ratio of exactly 1 gives the exact circle. The document records no tolerance.
- Below 1, the reader uses the circle only when `radius * (1 - ratio)` is not more than the tolerance in drawing units. Then the document records the tolerance. Otherwise the reader fits arcs.
- Pinned by `curve_bounds::a_near_round_ellipse_is_a_circle_only_within_the_tolerance`. The test checks the two sides of the limit (10 mm at ratio 0.99995 and 0.9998) and your case at radius 1e10 mm.
- The decision file has the changed paragraph.

One related gap for the same finding class: the Z check of 62b3fdf17 covers the SPLINE control points (group codes 10/20/30). The fit points (group codes 11/21/31) do not have the same check. A spline that has only fit points can mix an explicit Z with an omitted Z (= 0) and read as a flat curve.

We have a fix that applies the same rule to fit points, with tests. It is on a local branch only, because your commit came first. Do you want us to push it to this PR, or do you add it yourself? We do not push until you say which.

Fit point fix pushed: `1359ef98e` (`fix(geometry): validate each DXF spline fit point elevation`).

**The change**

- The SPLINE fit points (group codes 11/21/31) now use the same rule as the control points in `62b3fdf17`.
- Each fit point is X, Y and at most one Z. An omitted Z is 0.
- The reader refuses a Z before X and Y, a duplicate Z, a Y before X, and an X with no Y. Each refusal names the fit point.
- All fit points and all control points must be in one Z plane. Else the reader refuses the SPLINE with "fit points are not in one Z plane".
- The code is in `Fields::finish_fit` in `crates/geometry/src/dxf/curves.rs`. It has the same structure as `finish_control`, and the two share the `elevation` field.
- The decision file lists the new refusals.

**Tests**

- `curve_refusals::spline_fit_points_use_a_per_point_z_default`: a spline with only fit points, one explicit Z of 1 and one omitted Z, in the two orders, is refused. With control points, all Z omitted reads at 0, and all Z equal at 2 reads at 2. A mixed fit Z and a fit plane that is not the control plane are refused.
- `curve_refusals::spline_fit_points_refuse_orphan_and_duplicate_z`: orphan Z, out-of-order Z, duplicate Z, Y before X, and X with no Y are refused.
- The two tests failed on `8973feb08` and pass on `1359ef98e`.

**Gate on `1359ef98e`**

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: 1206 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, wall 30.3 min.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo xtask gate light --only "motion light" --only "app light"`: 5 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled.
